spans.s:
When a letter of अण् प्रत्यहार comes as a substitute for ऋ it is always followed by र्।

Terms:

The affixes यत् and तसि come in the sense of 'in the same direction with that' after the word उरस।

Terms: यत् and तसि

The affixes अण् and यत् come in the sense of 'made' after उरस् in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction.

Terms: अण् and यत्

The affix कप्‌ comes after उरस् etc. final in a बहुव्रीहि समास ।

Terms: कप्‌

is substituted for the ऋ or ॠ of the reduplicate.

Terms: Reduplicate
